title: New-Age Tech Stocks Continue Rally; E2E Network, Turtlemint Lead Gains

llm_summary: New‑age tech stocks kept their momentum this week, adding roughly $8 billion to their combined market value. Companies such as E2E Networks and Turtlemint were the standout performers, posting the biggest gains among the sector’s roughly 55 listed firms. The rally underscores continued investor confidence in emerging‑technology businesses despite broader market volatility.
